section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'The present study', outlines the methodology and hypotheses for a single study conducted with a sample of Romanian adults. The study aimed to examine the factor structure and psychometric properties of a Romanian translation of the BAS-2, including its internal consistency, test-retest reliability, and invariance across sex. It also planned to investigate convergent validity by examining associations with measures of disordered eating, self-esteem, satisfaction with life, subjective happiness, and BMI.
